title: Shawsheen Rubber Co., Inc. — FDA 실사 관찰사항 API (실사 종료 2023-03-13)

source_summary: Testing and release of drug product for distribution do not include appropriate laboratory determination of satisfactory conformance to the identity and strength of each active ingredient prior to release.
